Name: Content Pack version of lillvik's bigger standard farm
Author: LorSnore
Description:
Download, unzip, place in Mods folder like any Content Pack. See [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] mod for details on that.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2443]Original mod by lillvik[/url]﻿

Sorry for lazy cover photo, I just quickly made this for a group of people using the mod on a modded server, because xnb mods are less intuitive for casual people

Original author, lillvik, contact me if you want this taken down or upload it to your original mod page if you want

Tested only slightly in 1.3.28. If you make a file using the mod, and then take the mod out, there will be trees, debris, etc in your farm ponds, and probably in the unseen void(which take unnecessary resources), so be aware of that
